result.verdictNote: A dense, well-quantified resume with strong behavioural bullets, client exposure, leadership scope and academic selectivity signals. The main risks are three concurrent roles in 2026 (postdoc, co-founder/CTO, full-time Accenture) with no part-time labels, and undefined domain jargon (IND, CRO, rNPV, CRC-P). The layout is mostly single-column. I found no hidden or injected text.
